about: Readings the tokeniser gets wrong in these two decks (review finding F17). build.py applies them after tokenising and before ruby is built; they do not touch the app-wide lexicon in docs/content/reading-overrides.json. A rule sets `reading` (hiragana) on `surface` where the text right before it ends with a match of `after` and the text right after it starts with a match of `before` (both regexes, empty = anything). With `cards`, it applies only to the passages those card ids (from ids.json) are built from. A rule that matches nothing fails the build. tools/kotoba-deck-ruby.fixtures.json lists the readings the shipped decks must and must not show.

rules.after: (日本|外国|中国|宇宙|エジプト|文化|著名|星|オランダ|スウェーデン)
rules.note: nationality and kind of person: 日本人, 宇宙人, 文化人 (UniDic reads a separate 人 token as にん)
月曜日, 土曜日 (UniDic gives 曜 and 日 as separate tokens and reads 日 as ひ)
a whole day (一日のうちでも, 一日で楽しめる), not the first of the month; listed by card because 一日 is ついたち in dates
他の, 他に, 〜がある他、 mean other or besides (ほか); 自他, 排他, 利他 keep た
a polite word for a person (読者の方, 一般の方), not a direction or side
方 as an honorific plural after people
あればいい方で (it is lucky if …): ほう, not the かた of 言い方
恋愛上手, someone good at romance; not かみて (upstage)
the given name of 寛仁親王, not the word かんにん
